author: gemini-antigravity
scope: Genuine coupled staggered PDAS re-equilibration execution on non-coarsened C6 mesh (15,252 CPE4 quads, 15,559 physical nodes) at target uy = 0.0018703125 mm with fail-closed phase-field decoding (validating exactly 15,559 physical nodes and rejecting 2-component/mixed output) while preserving R4/R5 rigorous acceptance gates (omega_d = 0.5). Authorized for exactly 1 PBS submission; serial 1 CPU, 16 GB, 8 h.
scientific_hypothesis: Package 171-R1 exhibited nonconvergent alternating oscillations at Outer 100 (delta_d ~ 7.17e-3, delta_u ~ 4.51e-5 mm, delta_h ~ 271.5 MPa). Under the falsifiable numerical hypothesis omega_d = 0.5, convex damage relaxation dampens crack-tip strain-damage oscillatory feedback while strictly preserving d >= d0, d <= 1.0, post-relaxation KKT stationarity, coupled-field consistency (delta_u <= 1e-9 mm, delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa), fail-closed phase decoding, and non-accumulating history.

mathematical_formulation.mesh_level: C6 (15,252 CPE4 elements, 15,559 physical nodes + RP 999999, 59 duplicate seam-slit pairs)
mathematical_formulation.kkt_evaluation: Explicit post-relaxation KKT stationarity recomputation: solver.kkt(d^{k+1}, tau_active=1e-6, tau_free=1e-6) evaluated under corresponding H^{k+1}
mathematical_formulation.coupled_field_consistency: Final mechanical subproblem resolution on converged damage state to ensure u, d, H, RF, and energies refer to a mutually equilibrated state with delta_u <= 1e-9 mm and delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa
mathematical_formulation.phase_decoding: Strict fail-closed validation of exactly 15,559 unique physical-node records. Only documented 1-component damage or >=3-component U with damage in U3 accepted; 2-component (U1, U2), mixed counts, missing nodes, duplicate nodes, and nonfinite values rejected before clipping to d0
mathematical_formulation.obstacle_enforcement: Pointwise active-set Dirichlet clamp prescribed = {n: d0[n] for n in active} ensuring min(d - d0) >= -1.0e-6

source_differences: Package 171-R6 remediates the phase-field extraction data-integrity defect identified in Independent Review HND-F1602-R5-REVIEW-FD983824: (1) In solve_subproblem(), enforces fail-closed validation of exactly 15,559 unique physical-node records matching receiver mesh nodes, rejecting missing, duplicated, unexpected, or nonfinite (NaN/Inf) values; (2) In solve_subproblem(), for the phase subproblem, accepts strictly documented 1-component damage scalar output or >=3 component displacement output with damage in U3 (index 2); (3) In solve_subproblem(), strictly rejects 2-component phase output (U1, U2), mixed component counts, incomplete U3 coverage, and ambiguous extractor output, never interpreting v[-1] as damage by default; (4) Fails closed before clipping against d0, updating the damage field, or evaluating convergence, preserving the original endpoint and providing exact failure diagnostics; (5) Retains all verified R5 remediations: distinct 4 GP history loading from r[4+g] (61,008 GP histories), string-based keyword parsing, element-level *Initial Conditions SOLUTION serialization (16 SDVs), and extractor CLI arguments; (6) Retains all R4/R5 acceptance logic: consistency delta_u <= 1e-9 mm, consistency delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa, post-relaxation KKT <= 1e-6, zero healing, and force/energy drift <= 2.0%; (7) Adds comprehensive unit test suite test_package171_r6_c6_coupled_driver_phase_decoding.py (10 tests) covering valid U3, valid 1-component damage, 2-component rejection, mixed count rejection, duplicate/missing node rejection, and nonfinite rejection.
